Before Atomionics, he was a researcher at the Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD) and Nanyang TechnologicalUniversity (NTU).

He built an atomic sensing system with cold atoms from the ground up at the Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology Graduate University, Japan while pursuing his PhD.
